parameters.query: SELECT q.id AS quittance_id, q.contrat_id, q.locataire_id, q.proprietaire_id, q.montant_total_fcfa, q.date_echeance, q.statut, p.telephone AS locataire_tel, pp.telephone AS proprietaire_tel, CASE WHEN (q.date_echeance::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 3 THEN 'J-3' WHEN (q.date_echeance::date - CURRENT_DATE) = 1 THEN 'J-1' WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - q.date_echeance::date) = 1 THEN 'J+1' WHEN (CURRENT_DATE - q.date_echeance::date) = 7 THEN 'J+7' ELSE NULL END AS jalon FROM quittances q JOIN profiles p ON p.id = q.locataire_id JOIN profiles pp ON pp.id = q.proprietaire_id WHERE q.statut IN ('en_attente', 'en_retard') AND ((q.date_echeance::date - CURRENT_DATE) IN (3, 1) OR (CURRENT_DATE - q.date_echeance::date) IN (1, 7))
